authority_order: current explicit teacher instruction for the specific job
current Algebra Framework; exact embedded Unit Assessment Plan is exact Unit learning/evidence authority
current executable task PM for procedure
assessment_plan_rule: Exact Unit Assessment Plan owns Learning Targets, I Can statements, Intro/Review/Mastery placement, canonical Mastery Goals, evidence architecture, and Unit scope. Derivative indexes/profiles may operationalize but may not contradict it.
canonical_goal_identity: When the same goal moves Review -> Mastery, keep the exact goal ID/title/description. Stage changes support/evidence demand, not goal identity.
spiral_rule: Intro Unit N -> Review Unit N+1 -> Mastery Unit N+2; Review Unit N -> Mastery Unit N+1. Section numbers do not need to match across Units.
warmup_rule: Algebra Warm-Ups use a separate four-slot course-long fluency track: Solve / Diamond / Skill Review / Challenge. Do not route daily slots mechanically from Intro/Review/Mastery.
exit_rule: Normal official Exit Ticket = 2 new current-Mastery evidence opportunities + 2 fresh parallel reassessments of the previous section official Exit new evidence jobs. U1.1 is an intentionally unresolved opening exception until the Bank/Exit map is finalized.
bank_rule: Bank is authoritative but not exhaustive. It should hold the reusable content/evidence the Framework declares canonical; downstream instructional artifacts may purpose-author/refine aligned instances.
derivative_index_rule: If any JSON/index conflicts with exact Assessment Plan HTML, use the HTML and regenerate the derivative.
task_pm_rule: Task PM owns execution procedure and packaging. Framework owns Algebra-specific learning/evidence/resource behavior.
